task.title: Retry Payment event publication without direct Order writes

context: Payment publishes payment.authorized through the accepted event boundary.
The kickoff found that an unqualified write retry can violate the direct-write constraint.
requirements: Retry publication after a transient event-bus failure.
Reuse the original idempotency key on every retry.

constraints.constraint: Payment must not write the Order database directly.
The retry path must preserve event deduplication.

out_of_scope.statement: Direct Payment writes to the Order database.
Retry behavior that bypasses event deduplication.

acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a transient publish failure WHEN Payment retries THEN the original idempotency key is reused.
GIVEN duplicate delivery WHEN Order consumes the event THEN the state transition is applied once.
open_questions: Retry count and backoff remain implementation choices.
